title: Britecharts donut spec
description: A donut chart: the chart's name, its configuration (the accessors, commands and events the donut wrapper takes) and its data.

a11yDataTable.description: Gets or Sets whether the chart renders its data as a table that screen readers can read, row by row and cell by cell. The table is visually hidden, placed right after the svg and linked from it with `aria-details`; its caption is the chart's name. On by default: set it to false for an app that gives the data its own accessible form.

a11yDescription.description: Gets or Sets a longer description screen readers announce after the name, such as what the data shows. It is rendered as the svg's `<desc>` and linked with `aria-describedby`. Unset, there is no description.

a11yTitle.description: Gets or Sets the name screen readers announce for the chart. It is set as the svg's `aria-label`. Unset, the getter reads `null` and the chart is announced by its type, such as "Bar chart".

animationDuration.description: Gets or Sets the duration of the animation

centeredTextFunction.description: Gets or Sets the centeredTextFunction of the chart. If function is provided the format will be changed by the custom function's value format. The default format function value is "${d.percentage}% ${d.name}". The callback will provide the data object with id, name, percentage, and quantity. Also provides the component added by the user in each data entry.
centeredTextFunction.$comment: A function: set it from JavaScript, since JSON can't hold one.

colorMap.description: Gets or Sets the colorMap of the chart.

colorSchema.description: Gets or Sets the colorSchema of the chart

customBrushEnd.$comment: A function: set it from JavaScript, since JSON can't hold one.

customBrushStart.$comment: A function: set it from JavaScript, since JSON can't hold one.

customClick.$comment: A function: set it from JavaScript, since JSON can't hold one.

customMouseMove.$comment: A function: set it from JavaScript, since JSON can't hold one.

customMouseOut.$comment: A function: set it from JavaScript, since JSON can't hold one.

customMouseOver.$comment: A function: set it from JavaScript, since JSON can't hold one.

emptyDataConfig.description: Gets or Sets the emptyDataConfig of the chart. If set and data is empty (quantity adds up to zero or there are no entries), the chart will render an empty slice with a given color (light gray by default)

exportChart.description: Executes a command that triggers the download of the current chart: an svg file when the filename ends in `.svg`, and a png otherwise

externalRadius.description: Gets or Sets the externalRadius of the chart

hasCenterLegend.description: Gets or Sets whether the legend shows at the centre of the donut

hasFixedHighlightedSlice.description: Gets or Sets the hasFixedHighlightedSlice property of the chart, making it to highlight the selected slice id set with `highlightSliceById` all the time.

hasHoverAnimation.description: Gets or Sets the hasHoverAnimation property of the chart. By default, donut chart highlights the hovered slice. This property explicitly disables this hover behavior.

hasLastHoverSliceHighlighted.description: Gets or sets the hasLastHoverSliceHighlighted property. If property is true, the last hovered slice will be highlighted after 'mouseout` event is triggered. The last hovered slice will remain in highlight state. Note: if both hasFixedHighlightedSlice and hasLastHoverSliceHighlighted are true, the latter property will override the former.

height.description: Gets or Sets the height of the chart

highlightSliceById.description: Gets or Sets the id of the slice to highlight.

internalRadius.description: Gets or Sets the internalRadius of the chart

isAnimated.description: Gets or Sets the isAnimated property of the chart, making it to animate when render. Ignored when the reader's system asks for reduced motion

isLoading.description: Gets or Sets the loading state of the chart

margin.description: Gets or Sets the margin object of the chart (top, bottom, left and right)

numberFormat.description: Gets or Sets the number format of the chart. Null until one is set, where the shared declaration promises a string: this chart has no default format.

orderingFunction.description: Changes the order of items given custom function
orderingFunction.$comment: A function: set it from JavaScript, since JSON can't hold one.

percentageFormat.description: Gets or Sets the percentage format for the percentage label

radiusHoverOffset.description: Gets or Sets the radiusHoverOffset of the chart

width.description: Gets or Sets the width of the chart

percentage.description: Computed from the quantities when not given.

id.description: Only the legend feature needs it.
